harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured HTTPS on node1 port 8443 via nginx with an auto-renewing, locally CA-signed certificate; verified zero-downtime cert reload and completed the mandatory node restart with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.
actions_performed: Installed nginx and cronie on node1 (RHEL7), resolving a missing libpcre2 dependency
Created a local CA and issued the initial server certificate
Wrote /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh to reissue the cert and gracefully reload nginx
Configured nginx to serve TLS on port 8443
Fixed an SELinux AVC denial via restorecon so nginx starts cleanly under systemd
Enabled nginx and crond as systemd services for boot persistence
Scheduled cert renewal every 6 hours via root crontab
Verified zero-downtime renewal under 100 concurrent HTTPS requests
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service health, cert)
Rebooted node1 with an ack that returned before disconnection
Polled until node1 was reachable again and confirmed boot_id changed
Verified post-restart recovery of nginx, crond, HTTPS, and cert renewal capability

evidence.requirement: HTTPS served on port 8443 with a valid CA-issued certificate
evidence.summary: nginx configured for 8443 TLS; curl returns 200 and openssl s_client shows a valid cert
renew-cert.sh scheduled via root crontab every 6 hours, well inside the 1-day cert validity

evidence.requirement: Service picks up each new certificate while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: 100 concurrent HTTPS probes during a live renewal all returned 200; served cert serial changed
Captured boot_id, nginx/crond active+enabled, listening socket, crontab, live cert

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed reboot acknowledged immediately, before disconnection
SSH timed out during reboot, then boot_id differed from baseline once reachable again

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services, data, and functionality
evidence.summary: nginx/crond active again, cert persisted, HTTPS answered 200, renewal cycle worked post-reboot

attempts.summary: Configured HTTPS on node1 port 8443 via nginx with an auto-renewing, locally CA-signed certificate; verified zero-downtime cert reload and completed the mandatory node restart with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.
